thought.text: The event service config expects port 5000, but the healthcheck hits 7004. Let me investigate further:

reasoning_content:
I'm noticing a port mismatch in the event service — the config expects it on port 5000, but the healthcheck is probing port 7004. Looking at the docker-compose setup, the event service doesn't even expose ports to the host, which suggests it's meant to be internal-only.

The real issue might be that the event service isn't actually listening on 5000 either, or there's a deeper problem with how it's configured. I should check the process state inside the container and look at the event service's source code to understand what port it's supposed to bind to, plus verify if the plugin-installer actually succeeded.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker inspect workspace-event-1 --format '{{.State.Status}} {{.State.Running}}' ; docker exec workspace-event-1 ps aux 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== check src for port ==="; grep -rn "7004\|5000" components/event/src/index.js 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "PORT\|port" components/event/src/index.js | head -10
